description: Zielnetz des Konzepts Radnetz Brandenburg BB is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kundenservice. The Download Service (WFS) Target Network of the Radnetz Brandenburg concept provides data on the target network from the Radnetz Brandenburg concept. The cross-construction links of everyday cycling in the state of Brandenburg, defined in the target network, are presented. In addition, alternatives exist for certain compounds. Coverage: Kundenservice. The portal shows the English title as "WFS Target network of the concept Radnetz Brandenburg BB" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Kundenservice. Its keywords include opendata, Konzept, Radnetz Brandenburg, Radnetz, Zielnetz, Alltagsradverkehr. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
